title: Speaking — Handwritten notes
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on handwritten notes.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
What do you still write by hand?
Do you keep handwritten notes for a long time?

part2.topic: Describe a handwritten message that you were pleased to receive.
part2.closing: and explain why you appreciated the personal touch.

questions: Which skills might be lost if people seldom write by hand?
Why do some institutions still value handwritten records?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to handwritten notes?
